other_eligibility: Eligibility clause: 'CBS welcomes applications from motivated graduate applicants, of all genders, ages, nationalities and religions, who come from countries outside of EU/EEA and need a student residence permit to study at CBS.' Must be a non-EU/non-EEA/non-Swiss citizen, need a student residence permit, pay the application fee by the application deadline and upload a personal statement. Not available to anyone eligible for Danish SU or other Danish public support. Approximately 25 scholarships per year. Awarded on motivation and academic background, not financial need. The grant is taxable in Denmark.
deadline: 15 January 23:59 CET (Summer round) / 15 October (Winter round); results by 15 March (10 December for the Winter round)
deadline_relative_to: The scholarship deadline IS the admission deadline - you must apply for admission by 15 January and tick the scholarship option plus upload a personal statement at that time
application_route: apply via university (indicate the scholarship in the Application Portal and upload a personal statement with the admission application)

scholarship_name: Danish state scholarship at Aarhus University
funder: Danish state, administered by Aarhus University
amount_eur_year: 13000 (100% tuition fee waiver; Aarhus non-EU master fee 13000 EUR/year for 60 ECTS) plus, at Aarhus BSS, a monthly grant towards living expenses
duration_covered: Typically but not always the duration of the master's programme
other_eligibility: Only awarded to applicants liable to pay tuition fees, i.e. non-EU/EEA. Aarhus University has no scholarship funds of its own and relies entirely on Danish state funding. Aarhus BSS (which hosts the Track A programme) offers tuition fee waiver plus a monthly living grant; the Faculties of Natural Sciences and Technical Sciences offer tuition waiver only.
deadline: The master's programme application deadline
deadline_relative_to: Automatic and simultaneous - 'When you apply to Aarhus University, the university automatically considers you for Danish State Scholarships. You do not need to complete a separate application.' No additional documents should be uploaded.
application_route: apply via university (automatic on the admission application)

scholarship_name: Aalborg University scholarship for non-EU/EEA master's applicants
funder: Danish government, awarded by Aalborg University
amount_eur_year: 15490 tuition fee waiver plus a monthly stipend of DKK 11225 (stated as EUR 1503 per month) for 2026 new students
duration_covered: The four semesters of the master's programme
other_eligibility: Granted to individually selected applicants from non-EU/EEA countries on strategic considerations and academic qualifications. Approximately 15 scholarships each year for the September intake - Aalborg explicitly advises applicants not to rely on receiving one. If tuition has already been paid when the award is made, the fee is refunded.
deadline: The master's programme application deadline (awards notified by early July; AAU cannot guarantee a decision before the tuition payment deadline)
deadline_relative_to: Automatic - 'All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master's programme'; no separate scholarship application
application_route: apply via university (automatic on the admission application)

amount_eur_year: 12404 (full tuition fees; BI non-EU master fee NOK 135600 = 12404 EUR/year). Some candidates receive a one-year rather than two-year award.
duration_covered: Up to two years, subject to meeting the academic progression requirements
other_eligibility: Eligibility clause: 'Candidates with international citizenship who are not residents of Norway who have a strong academic record.' Minimum overall GPA of 4.0 on the ECTS scale (BI converts international grades). Must be admitted to a Master of Science programme and seeking a first master's degree. International citizens who completed a bachelor's in Norway count as domestic and are excluded. Awarded on academic grades, not financial need.
deadline_relative_to: Submitted at the same time as the admission application - scholarship applications by email are not accepted, and the scholarship is only considered once a complete admission application has been submitted and the offer of admission accepted
application_route: apply via university (upload CV and a one-page scholarship letter in the 'Scholarship' section of the online admission application)

funder: Nova School of Business and Economics
institutions_covered: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE) - Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
amount_eur_year: 2600 or 6500 (20% or 50% of the 13000 EUR non-EU master's tuition fee)
other_eligibility: Awarded on high academic performance; open to all nationalities. Combined Nova SBE funding cannot exceed 70% of total tuition unless it is a 100% social mobility scholarship. Does not fund the application fee, the first tuition instalment paid as enrolment fee, CEMS, Double Degree, additional semesters or exchange programmes. Fall intake only.
deadline: Closes when the master's application is submitted (Fall intake only)
deadline_relative_to: Declared inside the master's application form - admission to the programme is a prerequisite, so the scholarship interest must be flagged at the moment of applying
application_route: apply via university (declaration of interest within the master's application)

funder: Nova School of Business and Economics
institutions_covered: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE) - Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
amount_eur_year: 2600, 6500 or 13000 (20%, 50% or 100% of the 13000 EUR non-EU master's tuition fee)
other_eligibility: Eligibility clause: 'All candidates can apply for this scholarship, regardless of their country of origin.' Requires proven financial need with household income documentation (tax return). Combined Nova SBE funding cannot exceed 70% of tuition except where funding is entirely a 100% social mobility scholarship. Available for Fall and Spring intakes.
deadline: Closes when the master's application is submitted (Fall and Spring intakes)
deadline_relative_to: Declared inside the master's application form together with the tax return; admission is a prerequisite
application_route: apply via university (declaration of interest plus tax return within the master's application)

amount_eur_year: 14350 (up to a 50% reduction in tuition fees; EDHEC master fee 28700 EUR/year PRIOR_CYCLE)
other_eligibility: Supports high-potential candidates on the excellence of their academic profile, extensive experience and/or extracurricular activities. No nationality restriction stated - 'All admitted candidates are automatically considered for an EDHEC scholarship.'
deadline: NOT_FOUND (tied to the admission decision)
deadline_relative_to: Automatic from the admission application - the Scholarship Committee decision is conveyed by email at the same time as the admissions decision; no additional documentation is required
application_route: apply via university (automatic on admission)

amount_eur_year: 6990 (up to a 30% tuition waiver; IESEG master fee 23300 EUR/year)
other_eligibility: Awarded to meritorious international students on a strong overall profile - academics, test scores, motivation, extracurriculars and professional experience. IESEG charges the same tuition to French and international students. A separate general tuition waiver of up to 5000 EUR is also awarded case by case by the admissions committee.
deadline: NOT_FOUND (assessed at admission review)
deadline_relative_to: Automatic from the admission application - 'no separate application is required', awards are determined during the application review
application_route: apply via university (automatic on admission)

scholarship_name: Corvinus Early Bird tuition fee discount
amount_eur_year: 1080 (10% off the first-year tuition fee; Corvinus non-EU master fee 10800 EUR/year)
other_eligibility: No nationality restriction stated. Requires applying by the early-bird date AND completing the Corvinus admissions requirements by the end of March 2026. Distinct from the Corvinus Scholarship, which is limited to the MSc in Management and Leadership, MSc in Finance and the International MBA and therefore does not cover the Track A or Track B programmes at Corvinus.
deadline: 2026-01-26 (apply by this date), with admissions requirements completed by end of March 2026
deadline_relative_to: Before/at the programme application - the discount is determined solely by the date the application is submitted
application_route: apply via university (automatic on applying via the DreamApply platform by the early-bird date)
